resources.string: Shown while PocketIDE\'s computer is on, so the agents keep working when you use other apps. Has a Stop button.

Runs the user\'s own Linux computer (code-server and the AI agents they started) on the phone while the user works in other apps or the screen is off, shows that it is running, and lets the user stop it.
Agents keep working while you use other apps.
A sign-in page a program on the computer asked to open while PocketIDE was not on the screen.
Tap to open the sign-in page
